companyDescription: Launch + space systems · Electron/HASTE operational, Neutron debut targeted Q4 2026 · pending $8B Iridium acquisition (closing ~mid-2027) · Q2 2026 earnings land AFTER CLOSE today, Aug 10
priceNote: Live $62.71 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Aug 10) used $85.30, a -26.5% drift over 93 days. Neutron's first launch has slipped to 2027.
summary: ⚠️ THESIS BROKEN (timing) — the Aug 10 report dated Neutron's first launch as a Q4 2026 catalyst (2026-11-15). Per the Q3 2026 release coverage (secondary source; primary not retrieved), Neutron is now targeted for 2027, so the near-term binary is gone and that framing is void. Partial offsets: ~$515M of new Neutron contracts in Q3, 16 Neutron missions booked, and record backlog (~$3.6B). The $8B Iridium deal targets a mid-2027 close. The stock is -26.5% since Aug 10. At ~$37B cap, this is no longer a near-term catalyst play; the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 results — RESOLVED
catalysts.description: Record backlog (~$3.6B); $515M of new Neutron contracts; Neutron first launch moved to 2027.

risks: Earnings reactions cut both ways for this exact stock — a clean Q1 2026 beat sent RKLB +34%, but a Q4 2025 beat still triggered a -9.5% drop days later purely on Neutron-timeline news; after a 45.5% pre-earnings run into tonight's print, the bar for 'good enough' is higher than ever

Neutron has now slipped twice (originally early 2026, then Q1, now Q4 2026) — a real, repeatable pattern risk, and the new $397M SB-AMTI contract is explicitly tied to it, raising the cost of a third delay
Rich, pre-profit valuation — market cap has grown to ~$51B on a stock still guided to a net loss this quarter (EPS -$0.06 est.)

Extreme high-beta/sentiment-driven — the stock round-tripped roughly -61% then +45% within about a month on a mix of sector-wide and company-specific factors, showing how disconnected price action can be from any single data point
Iridium deal adds integration and dilution risk — $8B cash+stock transaction, new share issuance, and a long ~mid-2027 close mean execution risk stacks on top of the core launch business

analystTargets.note: Carried from Aug 3 aggregation; upside compressed as price has since run

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: HIGH — RKLB fell as much as 61% from its May peak on a sector-wide de-rating, then round-tripped +45% in under two weeks on contract wins. That swing shows sentiment, amplified by real news, is currently driving the tape more than any single fundamental data point.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.
